description: Machine-readable feature catalog for 21labs — mirrors docs/FEATURES.md. Consumed by /help/* routes, the in-app Help Center, and the assistant app_help tool.

features.name: TTS engines
features.summary: 17 offline text-to-speech engines: Kokoro, Qwen3-TTS, Fish Speech, Chatterbox, XTTS v2, ChatTTS and more.

features.name: Voice cloning
features.summary: Zero-shot voice cloning from a short reference clip (XTTS v2, Qwen3, Fish Speech, Chatterbox, F5-TTS).

features.name: Voice profiles
features.summary: Preset, cloned, or designed voices with per-engine settings.

features.name: Reference voice library
features.summary: Bundled celebrity/public-figure reference clips for cloning, incl. Twenty One Pilots (Tyler Joseph, Josh Dun).

features.name: Emotion presets
features.summary: Training-free DSP emotion coloring (happy/sad/angry/…) applied to any generation.

features.name: Audio tags
features.summary: Bracketed tags in text ([laughs], [pause]) rendered as real human samples.

features.name: RVC voice conversion
features.summary: Convert an existing recording to a downloaded RVC voice pack.

features.name: BYOK cloud providers
features.summary: Optional bring-your-own API key/endpoint per domain (tts/music/sfx/vc/llm), encrypted at rest.

features.name: Waveform editor
features.summary: Non-destructive clip editing: trim, split, fade, gain, reverse, normalize.

features.name: Pitch map
features.summary: Piano-roll style pitch editing (C3–C5).

features.name: Effects chain
features.summary: 30+ backend effects (EQ, compressor, reverb, delay, chorus, distortion, telephone, de-esser, auto-tune, vocoder, …) with live preview or backend render, drag-sortable with presets.

features.name: Spectrogram
features.summary: Frequency-domain visualization of audio; isolated stems get their own color scheme.

features.name: SMPTE timecode
features.summary: Frame-accurate position display with multiple frame rates.

features.name: A/B comparison
features.summary: Instant processed-vs-raw toggle.

features.name: Tape scrubber
features.summary: Variable-speed scrubbing through audio.

features.name: Transcription + subtitles
features.summary: Word-level Whisper transcription with SRT/VTT subtitle export.

features.name: Transcript editing
features.summary: Edit audio by editing its words — click-to-playhead and filler removal.

features.name: Noise reduction
features.summary: DeepFilterNet neural denoise plus spectral gate cleanup.

features.name: Audio enhance
features.summary: LavaSR neural upscale to 48 kHz + denoise (auto mode).

features.name: Loudness metering
features.summary: Integrated/short-term LUFS + true peak measurement.

features.name: Import
features.summary: Import audio files and extract audio from video.

features.name: Multi-track mixer
features.summary: VU meters, mute/solo, pan, per-track FX, bus routing.

features.name: Auto-duck
features.summary: Speech automatically ducks music beds.

features.name: Mastering
features.summary: Glue compression + limiting + LUFS normalization to broadcast targets.

features.name: Platform export
features.summary: One-tap delivery presets: Spotify, YouTube, Audible, podcast, film, social.

features.name: Reaper export
features.summary: Render the project to a .rpp Reaper file for handoff.

features.name: Lottie export
features.summary: Audio-reactive Lottie animation export.

features.name: Stories
features.summary: Audiobook/chapter sequencing: per-item fade/gain/trim/reorder, one mixed WAV out.

features.name: Conversation mode
features.summary: Stage multi-speaker lines, auto-duck overlaps, auto-level to LUFS.

features.name: ADR mode
features.summary: Acted Dialogue Replacement over picture: guide track, takes, scoring, lock.

features.name: Multi-take comping
features.summary: Stack takes, pick best regions, assemble a composite clip.

features.name: AI Audio Plan
features.summary: Script → scene-based track/voice/music assignment blueprint.

features.name: Batch queue
features.summary: Run many generations with status, cancel, and retry.

features.name: Content recipes
features.summary: Proven pipelines per content type (podcast, audiobook, ad, short…).

features.name: Voice changer
features.summary: Live mic pipeline: VAD → DeepFilter denoise → Whisper → TTS → LavaSR.

features.name: Voice chat (STS)
features.summary: Speech-to-speech voice agent: talk to the assistant, it answers in voice with barge-in.

features.name: Dictate window
features.summary: Floating always-on capture window with a global hotkey chord.

features.name: Streaming STT
features.summary: Live partial transcription while you speak.

features.name: Music generation
features.summary: Full songs from a text prompt via ACE-Step.

features.name: SFX generation
features.summary: One-shot sound effects from text via Stable Audio Open.

features.name: Bark non-verbals
features.summary: Laughs, sighs, gasps, coughs — human reaction sounds.

features.name: GM instruments
features.summary: Piano/bass/strings/brass/bells via an offline SoundFont.

features.name: Drum machine
features.summary: 16-step patterns from synthesized drum hits.

features.name: DSP synth
features.summary: Pure offline synthesis (no AI): waveforms and classical effects.

features.name: Freesound browser
features.summary: Search Freesound SFX with your own API key.

features.name: Binaural positioning
features.summary: HRTF 3D placement via Steam Audio SDK with bundled SOFA.

features.name: Doppler
features.summary: Moving-source pitch/pan automation.

features.name: Convolution reverb
features.summary: Impulse-response based spaces.

features.name: In-app AI assistant
features.summary: Local LFM2.5 LLM (llama.cpp) or your BYOK endpoint; calls 120+ studio tools.

features.name: MCP server
features.summary: 110+ tools exposed at /mcp for Claude Code, Cursor, and other MCP clients.

features.name: Scripting
features.summary: Scriptable server functions.

features.name: Automation lanes
features.summary: Volume/pan/pitch/FX over time plus a live cue matrix.

features.name: Agent skills
features.summary: Recipes and methodology in .agents/skills/ for AI agents producing pro output.

features.name: Model manager
features.summary: Download/load/unload/delete models with CUDA/ONNX device strategy.

features.name: Shortcuts
features.summary: Keymaps for 21labs / Premiere / DaVinci / Pro Tools styles.

features.name: Standalone projects
features.summary: Template-based project create/save/load.

features.name: Cross-tab audio bus
features.summary: Route live audio between tabs with a video preview monitor.

features.name: Community presets
features.summary: Search, browse, and import shared effect presets.

features.name: Telemetry
features.summary: Opt-in, privacy-respecting usage toggle.

features.name: Non-destructive edits
features.summary: Undo/redo and versions on every operation.

features.name: Stitch tracks
features.summary: Join the selected track end-to-end with another: adjustable crossfade, gap of silence, and fade curve. Lands on a new track.

features.name: Duplicate track
features.summary: Clone a track with its audio, effect chain, and automation for variation takes.

features.name: Render FX
features.summary: Render a track's full effect chain through the backend onto a new track — covers render-only effects the live preview cannot play.

features.name: Stem isolation
features.summary: Split vocals, drums, bass, or other stems out of a mix (or remove one) into a color-coded new track.
